name: Alabama Coast Campground
description: Alabama Coast Campground is a family owned and operated RV park, open year round and taking reservations for your upcoming stay. We offer a 10% Good Sam discount. Whether you're coming for the nearby attractions or to escape into nature, we can't wait to welcome you to our little slice of Alabama heaven! In order to provide the best camping experience at the best value, we do not have a shower house or a pool. Some amenities we DO have are a large playground area, a clubhouse, multipurpose sports field, three dog parks, beach volleyball, a free laundry, a 3/4 mile nature trail around the campground, several common areas and the largest Live Oak you've ever seen! All in a safe quiet natural setting close to everything the area has to offer. We provide a unique camping experience with amazing area attractions and activities like water sports, amusement park, beautiful beaches and so on. Our beautiful grounds are perfect for birthday parties and other events. We also host various entertaining events like occasional live music, concerts, movie nights and much more. If you want to spend your summer vacation in a peaceful place full of fun and entertainment, we are the ideal place for you and we can't wait to welcome you.
